snippet.title: DON'T FRET - Official Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
DON'T FRET - Official Release Date Announcement

Don't Fret will be dropping on December 8th! 

🎮 Wishlist DON'T! FRET
Steam: https://bit.ly/4voLsMk
Xbox: https://bit.ly/3VlIpYU
Playstation: https://bit.ly/4z3QXSt

Play as a sentient guitar named Fret, trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

Official Discord Community: https://discord.gg/VtsTBCy49j
Official Website: https://dontfretgame.com/

Publisher Info
Published by Digital Pajamas: https://digitalpajamas.com/
Co-Published by Miss Behavior - https://www.bhvr.com/
